name: StateLabel
statusNote: Alpha in Primer React, accessibility-reviewed 2025-01-08; GitHub uses it on every issue, pull request and alert. The legacy variant prop (normal/small) is deprecated in favour of size.
summary: A filled pill with an octicon that states an issue's, pull request's or alert's lifecycle state (Open, Closed, Merged, Draft...). Choose it over Label only for that state; the status picks both colour and icon.

inputs.name: status
inputs.description: The state; it fixes the colour, the icon and the icon's spoken label.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The visible state word (children), e.g. Open, Closed, Merged.

anatomy.name: Container
anatomy.description: A filled pill in the status's emphasis background with a 1px inset ring in the matching emphasis border colour.

anatomy.name: Status icon
anatomy.description: The status's 16px octicon in --fgColor-onEmphasis, 4px before the text; absent for open and closed. At small it is drawn 1em (12px) wide.

anatomy.name: Text
anatomy.description: Semibold body text in --fgColor-onEmphasis on a 16px line.

variants.description: issueOpened (issue-opened icon), pullOpened (git-pull-request), alertOpened (shield) and open (no icon): the open colour.
issueClosed (issue-closed), pullMerged (git-merge), alertFixed (shield-check) and closed (no icon): the done (purple) colour.
pullClosed (git-pull-request-closed) and alertClosed (shield-x): the closed (red) colour.
draft (git-pull-request-draft), issueDraft (issue-draft) and alertDismissed (shield-slash): the draft colour, falling back to neutral.
issueClosedNotPlanned (skip), unavailable (alert) and archived (archive): the neutral colour.
4px by 8px padding, small body text: 24px tall.
8px by 12px padding, medium body text: 32px tall.

layout.text: Height comes from padding around a fixed 16px line: --base-size-4 by --base-size-8 at small (24px tall), --base-size-8 by --base-size-12 at medium (32px tall). Width hugs the icon and text.
Icon and text sit in a centred row; the icon has a --base-size-4 (4px) end margin and, at small, a width of 1em so it scales to the 12px text.
The border is a 1px inset ring (--boxShadow-thin) in the status's --borderColor-*-emphasis, drawn inside the box so it takes no layout space; text is centred and semibold in --fgColor-onEmphasis.

states.text: One static appearance per status: no hover, press, focus or disabled styling.

behaviour.text: The status alone selects the icon and colour; the visible text is the caller's and is not derived from the status.
The deprecated variant prop maps small to small and anything else to medium; size wins when both are given.

accessibility.role: none (a generic span containing an img icon and text)
semantics: The icon carries an aria-label naming the object type: Issue, Pull request, Issue, not planned, Alert, or Archived; unavailable has an empty label. The visible text follows, so a reader hears e.g. "Pull request Merged".
open and closed render no icon, so only the text is read.

notes.text: closed and issueClosed are done (purple), not closed (red); only pullClosed and alertClosed read the closed colour. Merged is also done.
Draft statuses fall back to the neutral tokens when the draft tokens are undefined; the resolved file defines both draft tokens, so read them.

The ring's border token equals or nearly equals the fill token in the resolved themes (done is identical; open's border is a shade darker in light), so the ring is barely visible. Draw it anyway: the tokens are bound separately and a theme may set them apart.
The 16px line height and the small icon's 1em width are literals, not tokens.
